tool_schemas.name: search-companies
tool_schemas.description: Searches company records within the specified workspace using a free-text query and returns a paged list of matching companies plus an opaque cursor for the next page when more results are available (use limit/cursor). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is not a valid att_ws_ ULID, limit is outside 1–100, sort/order/status are not one of the allowed values, or cursor is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) to scope the search.

query.description: Free-text query to match against company records (e.g., name, domain, attributes).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: advanced-search-companies
tool_schemas.description: Searches companies in the specified workspace using the provided structured filters (optionally combined with a free-text query) and returns a paged list of matching companies plus a next-page cursor when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is invalid, filters is missing/invalid, limit is outside 1–100, sort/order/status are not allowed, or cursor is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks workspace access, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) to scope the search.

filters.description: Advanced filter object applied to company records (field/value operators).

query.description: Optional free-text query combined with filters for company search.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: search-companies-by-domain
tool_schemas.description: Finds companies in the specified workspace by matching the provided domain/website host and returns a paged list of matches plus an opaque cursor for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is invalid, domain is missing/invalid, limit is outside 1–100, status is not allowed, or cursor is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) to scope the search.

domain.description: Company domain/website host to match (e.g., example.com).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: smart-search-companies
tool_schemas.description: Performs an intelligent company search in the specified workspace by interpreting the query (e.g., domain, email, URL, or name) and returning a paged list of the best matches plus a cursor for fetching subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is invalid, query is missing, limit is outside 1–100, status is not allowed, or cursor is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks workspace access, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) to scope the search.

query.description: Mixed-content query (name/domain/email/url) used for intelligent company search.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create-company
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new company record in the specified workspace with the provided fields/attributes (and optional raw_json) and returns the created company record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is invalid, display_name is missing/invalid, or any provided fields violate schema constraints. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot create records in the workspace, CONFLICT when the request would create a duplicate that the workspace rules disallow, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) where the company will be created.

phone.description: Primary phone number for the company.

social.description: Social profile data for the company (provider-specific fields).

business.description: Business-related structured fields for the company.

attributes.description: Additional Attio attributes to set on the company record.

raw_json.description: Raw upstream-compatible payload for advanced fields not explicitly modeled.

tool_schemas.name: update-company
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing company record in the specified workspace and returns the updated record (including any server-side merges/overwrites for attributes). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id/record_id are invalid, status is not one of active/archived/deleted, or provided fields are not valid for a company update. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company record does not exist in the workspace, CONFLICT when the requested update is not allowed due to record state or versioning rules, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) that owns the company record.

record_id.description: Local company record id to update (att_rec_... ULID).

social.description: Updated social profile data for the company.

business.description: Updated business-related structured fields for the company.

attributes.description: Updated Attio attributes for the company record (merged/overwritten server-side).

raw_json.description: Raw upstream-compatible payload for advanced fields not explicitly modeled.

tool_schemas.name: update-company-attribute
tool_schemas.description: Sets or unsets a single attribute on the specified company record and returns the updated company (or the updated attributes payload) after applying the change. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id/record_id are invalid, attribute_name is missing/invalid, mode is not set|unset, or attribute_value is missing when mode=set. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company record does not exist, CONFLICT when the attribute update is refused due to record state or attribute constraints, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) that owns the company record.

record_id.description: Local company record id to update (att_rec_... ULID).

attribute_name.description: Attribute key/name to update on the company (as stored in attributes).

attribute_value.description: Value to set for the attribute (any JSON type).

mode.description: How to apply the attribute update.

tool_schemas.name: delete-company
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified company record and returns the resulting record state (or a deletion acknowledgement), using hard_delete=true for permanent removal and hard_delete=false to apply a soft-delete behavior when supported. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id/record_id are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND when the record does not exist, CONFLICT when the record cannot be deleted due to its current state or server rules, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) that owns the company record.

record_id.description: Local company record id to delete (att_rec_... ULID).

hard_delete.description: If true, permanently delete; if false, mark as deleted/archived depending on server behavior.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-fields
tool_schemas.description: Returns only the requested fields for the specified company record (by field name list) and does not include other properties not explicitly requested. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id/company_record_id are invalid or when fields contains unsupported field names. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company record does not exist in the workspace, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the workspace/record, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to query within.

company_record_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company.

fields.description: Record field names to return for the company.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-custom-fields
tool_schemas.description: Get custom fields for a company

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to query within.

company_record_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company.

tool_schemas.name: discover-company-attributes
tool_schemas.description: Returns the workspace’s company attribute catalog (the set of attribute keys and their definitions) for the provided workspace_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is missing or does not match the expected ULID format, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not mirrored locally. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) whose attribute catalog should be inspected.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-attributes
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full attributes object for the specified company record, or (when attribute_name is provided) returns only that attribute’s value. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required id is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace or company_record_id does not exist in the workspace; if attribute_name is provided and is not a known attribute key, raises NOT_FOUND. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized for the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to query within.

company_record_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company.

attribute_name.description: Optional attribute key to fetch a single attribute value from the company's attributes object.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-notes
tool_schemas.description: Lists notes linked to the specified company, filtered by status and ordered by the requested sort/order; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor returned for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, unsupported cursor, or out-of-range limit, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace or company record cannot be found. Raises FORBIDDEN when you do not have access to the workspace/company, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to query within.

company_record_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company whose notes should be returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Field to sort returned notes by.

status.description: Filter notes by status (notes are typically 'active'; included for parity with activity storage).

tool_schemas.name: create-company-note
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new note linked to the specified company and returns the created note, including its id, timestamps, and any stored metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if body is empty, ids are malformed, or metadata is not an object, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace, company_record_id, or (when provided) author_record_id cannot be found in the workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to create notes in the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to create the note in.

company_record_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company to link the note to.

author_record_id.description: Optional local record id (ULID) of the author (typically a person record).

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary metadata to store on the note.

tool_schemas.name: search-companies-by-people
tool_schemas.description: Searches for companies that are associated with people matching people_query, optionally applying additional company_filters; results are sorted and paged with limit and an opaque cursor for continuation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, people_query contains unsupported fields, or pagination parameters are invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to search within the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to search within.

people_query.description: Filters applied to associated people (person records).

text.description: Full-text query applied to person fields (e.g., display_name/email/domain).

attributes.description: Attribute filters applied to person attributes (key/value pairs).

status.description: Filter associated people by record status.

company_filters.description: Optional filters applied to the returned companies.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Field to sort returned companies by.

tool_schemas.name: search-companies-by-people-list
tool_schemas.description: Searches for companies that have associated people who are members of the specified people_list_id, optionally applying company_filters; results are sorted and paged using limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids or invalid pagination/sort parameters, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace or people list does not exist in the workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the workspace or list, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to search within.

people_list_id.description: Local list id (ULID) of the list containing people whose companies should be returned.

company_filters.description: Optional filters applied to the returned companies.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Field to sort returned companies by.

tool_schemas.name: search-companies-by-notes
tool_schemas.description: Searches for companies with notes whose content matches the provided query using the requested match mode, optionally filtering by note_status and updated_after; results are sorted and paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty, updated_after is not a valid date-time, or pagination/sort parameters are invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to search notes in the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the search.

query.description: Text to search for within note bodies (and optionally titles).

match.description: How to match the query text against note content.

include_archived.description: Whether to include archived companies in results.

note_status.description: Filter notes by status when searching.

updated_after.description: Only include companies whose matching notes were updated after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-lists
tool_schemas.description: Lists lists that the specified company belongs to, optionally filtering by list_type, list status, and whether removed entries should be included; results are sorted and paged using limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids or invalid pagination/sort parameters, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace or company cannot be found. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view list membership in the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the query.

company_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company.

include_removed.description: Whether to include lists where the company entry has been removed.

list_type.description: Filter results to lists of a specific type.

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination.

tool_schemas.name: batch-create-companies
tool_schemas.description: Create multiple companies in a single batch operation

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) in which to create companies.

email.description: Primary email for the company (if applicable).

phone.description: Primary phone number for the company.

social.description: Social profile data blob mirrored from Attio.

contact.description: Contact/location details blob mirrored from Attio.

business.description: Business details blob mirrored from Attio.

attributes.description: Custom attribute values for the company.

raw_json.description: Raw upstream Attio payload to store alongside the company.

attio_object.description: Upstream Attio object identifier for the company record type.

attio_record_id.description: Upstream Attio record id (if already known) to link/mirror.

status.description: Initial status for the company record in the local store.

tool_schemas.name: batch-update-companies
tool_schemas.description: Update multiple companies in a single batch operation

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) in which to update companies.

company_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company to update.

attributes.description: Updated custom attribute values (object merged/replaced per backend semantics).

attio_record_id.description: Upstream Attio record id to link/mirror.

status.description: Updated local status for the company.

tool_schemas.name: batch-delete-companies
tool_schemas.description: Deletes up to 200 company records in the given workspace, either soft-deleting them (default) or permanently removing them when hard_delete is true, and returns a per-id result indicating which deletes succeeded and which failed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/company_ids are malformed, company_ids is empty or exceeds 200, or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND for any company_id that does not exist in the workspace and CONFLICT when a company cannot be deleted due to its current state or constraints enforced by the workspace (for example, already hard-deleted), and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) in which to delete companies.

company_ids.description: Local record ids (ULIDs) of companies to delete.

hard_delete.description: If true, permanently delete; otherwise mark as deleted.

tool_schemas.name: batch-search-companies
tool_schemas.description: Runs up to 50 independent company searches within a workspace and returns an array of results in the same order as the requests; each search returns a list of matching companies plus an opaque next_cursor when more results are available, using the per-search limit and cursor for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, searches is empty or exceeds 50, limit is outside 1–200, status/sort/order are not one of the allowed values, or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises RATE_LIMITED when batch or workspace search quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the searches.

searches.description: Search requests to run in a single batch.

query.description: Free-text query to match against company fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return for this search.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination for this search.

tool_schemas.name: batch-get-company-details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches details for up to 200 companies in the given workspace and returns a per-id result set, optionally including each record’s raw_json when include_raw_json is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/company_ids are malformed, company_ids is empty or exceeds 200, or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND for any company_id that does not exist in the workspace and may raise RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the lookup.

company_ids.description: Local record ids (ULIDs) of companies to fetch.

include_raw_json.description: Whether to include the raw_json payload in results.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-details
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full normalized company record for the given company_id in the workspace, optionally including raw_json when include_raw_json is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/company_id are malformed or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company_id does not exist in the workspace and may raise RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the lookup.

company_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company to fetch.

include_raw_json.description: Whether to include the raw_json payload in the response.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-json
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored raw_json payload for the specified company record in the workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/company_id are malformed or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company_id does not exist in the workspace or has no raw_json available, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the lookup.

company_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-basic-info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the company’s basic identity fields (such as display name and status) for the specified company_id in the workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/company_id are malformed or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company_id does not exist in the workspace and may raise RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the lookup.

company_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-contact-info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the company’s contact fields (such as email, phone, and domain when available) for the specified company_id in the workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/company_id are malformed or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company_id does not exist in the workspace and may raise RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the lookup.

company_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-business-info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the company’s business profile fields (the mirrored business info blob and related normalized fields) for the specified company_id in the workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/company_id are malformed or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company_id does not exist in the workspace and may raise RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the lookup.

company_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get-company-social-info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the company’s social profile fields (the mirrored social info blob and related normalized fields) for the specified company_id in the workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/company_id are malformed or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND when the company_id does not exist in the workspace and may raise RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the lookup.

company_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the company to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: create-person
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new person record in the specified workspace using the provided fields (at minimum display_name) and returns the created record, including its generated att_rec_… id and any normalized fields derived from the body. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, body.display_name is missing, or body contains fields outside the allowed schema; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to create records in the workspace. Raises CONFLICT if the create is refused due to workspace constraints (for example, uniqueness rules enforced for key identifiers) and may raise RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) where the person will be created.

body.description: Fields to set on the new person record.

display_name.description: Person display name (full name as shown in CRM).

email.description: Primary email address for the person.

phone.description: Primary phone number for the person.

contact.description: Structured contact info blob mirrored from Attio.

business.description: Structured business info blob mirrored from Attio.

attributes.description: Attio attribute map for the record (custom fields, etc.).

attio_object.description: Attio object key/name for this record (used for custom schemas).

raw_json.description: Optional raw Attio-shaped JSON payload to store alongside normalized fields.

tool_schemas.name: get-person-details
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full local person record for the given workspace_id and person_id, including stored Attio fields and timestamps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/person_id are not valid ULIDs or the person_id is not a person record, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace or person does not exist in the local mirror. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the lookup.

person_id.description: Local record id (ULID) of the person to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: search-people
tool_schemas.description: Searches mirrored person records in the specified workspace using an optional free-text query plus structured filters (including status, exact email/domain, time-window filters, and attribute key/value constraints), returning a single page of results up to limit along with an opaque cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid workspace_id, invalid filter/sort shapes, unsupported sort fields, malformed date-time values, or limit outside 1–200, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to search within.

query.description: Free-text query applied to person records (e.g., name/email/domain).

filters.description: Structured filters applied to person records.

last_interaction_after.description: Only include people with last_interaction_at after this timestamp.

last_interaction_before.description: Only include people with last_interaction_at before this timestamp.

last_activity_after.description: Only include people with last_activity_at after this timestamp.

last_activity_before.description: Only include people with last_activity_at before this timestamp.

attributes.description: Match against Attio attributes (custom field map).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-email
tool_schemas.description: Finds mirrored person records in the specified workspace by matching the email field using match_type (exact or contains), returning up to limit results and an opaque cursor for pagination when additional matches exist; results can be filtered by status and sorted using sort/sort_direction. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, email is missing/invalid, match_type/status/sort/sort_direction are not allowed values, or limit is outside 1–200, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...).

email.description: Email address to match against person records.

match_type.description: How to match the email value.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-phone
tool_schemas.description: Finds mirrored person records in the specified workspace by matching normalized phone numbers using match_type (exact or contains), returning up to limit results and an opaque cursor for pagination when additional matches exist; results can be filtered by status and sorted using sort/sort_direction. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, phone is missing, match_type/status/sort/sort_direction are not allowed values, or limit is outside 1–200, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...).

phone.description: Phone number to match against person records (raw input; server normalizes).

match_type.description: How to match the phone value.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: advanced-search-people
tool_schemas.description: Runs an advanced search over mirrored person records in the specified workspace, combining an optional free-text query with structured filters (status, ranged timestamps, exact email/domain/phone, attributes, and optional attio_object), returning up to limit results and an opaque cursor for pagination when more matches exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid workspace_id, malformed date-time ranges (including invalid gte/lte shapes), unsupported filter keys, invalid sort/sort_direction, or limit outside 1–200, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...).

query.description: Free-text query matched against person fields (e.g., name, email, domain).

filters.description: Structured filters applied to person records.

gte.description: Created at or after this time (inclusive).

lte.description: Created at or before this time (inclusive).

gte.description: Updated at or after this time (inclusive).

lte.description: Updated at or before this time (inclusive).

gte.description: Last interaction at or after this time (inclusive).

lte.description: Last interaction at or before this time (inclusive).

gte.description: Last activity at or after this time (inclusive).

lte.description: Last activity at or before this time (inclusive).

attributes.description: Filter by Attio attributes object (exact-key matching; server-defined semantics).

attio_object.description: Filter by Attio object identifier for custom record modeling.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-creation-date
tool_schemas.description: Searches mirrored person records in the specified workspace whose local created_at falls within the inclusive range [created_from, created_to], optionally filtered by status, returning up to limit results and an opaque cursor for pagination when additional matches exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, created_from/created_to are malformed date-times or the range is invalid, status is not an allowed value, or limit is outside 1–200, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-modification-date
tool_schemas.description: Search for people by their last modification date

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-last-interaction
tool_schemas.description: Search for people by their last interaction date

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...).

last_interaction_from.description: Start of last interaction date range (inclusive).

last_interaction_to.description: End of last interaction date range (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-activity
tool_schemas.description: Search for people by their activity history

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...).

activity_type.description: Filter people by linked activity type.

activity_from.description: Only include people with activity on/after this time (inclusive).

activity_to.description: Only include people with activity on/before this time (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-person-notes
tool_schemas.description: Get notes for a person

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...).

status.description: Filter notes by status (notes are typically 'active' or 'deleted').

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: create-person-note
tool_schemas.description: Creates a note attached to the specified person record in the given workspace and returns the created note object (including its generated note id, timestamps, and any stored metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, ids do not match the expected ULID formats, or body is empty; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace, person record, or optional author record does not exist in that workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to create notes in the workspace or on that record, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if note creation is rate-limited or exceeds workspace limits.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID that owns the person record.

person_record_id.description: Local record ULID of the person to attach the note to.

author_record_id.description: Optional local record ULID of the author (a record in this workspace).

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata for the note.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-company
tool_schemas.description: Searches people in a workspace by applying filters to their associated company records (company_query) and optional additional constraints on the returned people (person_query), returning a paged result set ordered by the requested sort; responses include up to limit people and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, company_query is missing/invalid, limit is out of range, or sort/sort_direction are not supported; raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to search this workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when search requests exceed rate or workload limits.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID to search within.

company_query.description: Filter criteria applied to associated company records.

text.description: Full-text query applied to company display_name/domain and indexed company fields.

domain.description: Exact or partial company domain to match.

attributes.description: Attribute-based filters against company attributes (schema depends on workspace catalog).

person_query.description: Optional additional filters applied to person records returned.

text.description: Full-text query applied to person display_name/email and indexed person fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of people to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-company-list
tool_schemas.description: Searches for people whose associated company records are members of the specified list, returning a paginated set of people (up to limit) and a next cursor when additional matches exist, sorted according to sort and sort_direction. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, limit is out of range, or sort/sort_direction are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or list does not exist (or the list is not visible to you in that workspace). Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the workspace/list or to run search, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the operation is rate-limited.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID to search within.

list_id.description: Local list ULID containing the company records.

person_query.description: Optional filters applied to people at companies in the list.

text.description: Full-text query applied to person display_name/email and indexed fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of people to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: search-people-by-notes
tool_schemas.description: Searches people in a workspace by matching the provided query against the bodies of notes linked to people, returning a paged list of matching people ordered by the requested sort with an opaque cursor for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is invalid, query is missing/empty, limit is out of range, or sort/sort_direction are unsupported; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to search notes in the workspace, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when search throughput limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID to search within.

query.description: Text to search for within note bodies linked to people.

limit.description: Maximum number of people to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-lists
tool_schemas.description: Lists CRM lists for the workspace (pipelines, segments, static lists, etc.) with optional filtering by list_type, applies_to, and status, returning up to limit results and a cursor for the next page when more lists match. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is malformed, filters contain unsupported values, or limit is out of range; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to list metadata for the workspace, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if listing is rate-limited.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID to fetch lists for.

applies_to.description: Optional filter for what record types the list applies to.

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-record-list-memberships
tool_schemas.description: Returns the CRM lists that the specified record belongs to (including membership/list-entry status), paged by limit with an opaque cursor for subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, limit is out of range, or status is not one of the supported values; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or record does not exist in that workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to view the record or list memberships, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds rate limits.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID containing the record.

record_id.description: Local record ULID to find list memberships for.

status.description: Filter memberships by list entry status.

limit.description: Maximum number of memberships to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-list-details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the list’s configuration and metadata (such as stages/fields configuration where applicable) for the specified list in the workspace and returns the full list detail object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id or list_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or list does not exist in that workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to view the list, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the endpoint is rate-limited.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID containing the list.

list_id.description: Local list ULID to fetch details for.

tool_schemas.name: get-list-entries
tool_schemas.description: Lists entries for a specific list, optionally filtered by entry status and linked record_type, returning up to limit list entries per page and a next cursor when more entries are available, ordered by the requested sort and sort_direction. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, limit is out of range, filters are invalid, or sort/sort_direction are unsupported; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or list does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the list or its entries, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when requests exceed rate limits.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID containing the list.

list_id.description: Local list ULID to fetch entries for.

record_type.description: Optional filter by the linked record's type.

limit.description: Maximum number of list entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Sort order for returned list entries.

tool_schemas.name: filter-list-entries
tool_schemas.description: Filter entries in a list by a specific attribute

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the query.

list_id.description: Local list id (ULID) whose entries will be filtered.

attribute_key.description: Entry attribute key inside entry_attributes to filter on (e.g., stage, owner, score).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: advanced-filter-list-entries
tool_schemas.description: Filter entries in a list with advanced multiple conditions

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the query.

list_id.description: Local list id (ULID) whose entries will be filtered.

attribute_key.description: Entry attribute key inside entry_attributes to filter on.

value.description: Comparison value (omit or set null when operator is 'exists').

conditions.description: List of attribute conditions combined with match mode.

match.description: Whether all conditions must match or any condition must match.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: add-record-to-list
tool_schemas.description: Creates a list entry linking the given record to the given list in the specified workspace, optionally setting list-entry-specific attributes, and returns the created list entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID is malformed, required fields are missing, or entry_attributes is not an object; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace, list, or record does not exist or the list is not in the workspace. Raises CONFLICT if the record is already an active entry in the list or if the list/record types are incompatible for membership, and raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to modify lists in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) that owns the list and record.

list_id.description: Local list id (ULID) to add the record to.

record_id.description: Local record id (ULID) to add as a list entry.

entry_attributes.description: Optional list-entry-specific attributes to set on creation (e.g., stage, probability).

tool_schemas.name: remove-record-from-list
tool_schemas.description: Marks the list entry for the given (list_id, record_id) as removed in the specified workspace and returns the updated list entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID is malformed or required fields are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or list does not exist, or if no list entry exists for that record in that list. Raises CONFLICT if the entry is already removed, and raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to modify list membership in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) that owns the list entry.

list_id.description: Local list id (ULID) to remove the record from.

record_id.description: Local record id (ULID) to remove from the list.

tool_schemas.name: update-list-entry
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified list entry in the given workspace by replacing entry_attributes and/or changing its status, and returns the updated list entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed, status is not one of active/removed, or entry_attributes is not an object; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or list entry does not exist or the entry is not in the workspace. Raises CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed (for example, removing an already removed entry), and raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to update list entries in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) that owns the list entry.

list_entry_id.description: Local list entry id (ULID) to update.

entry_attributes.description: List-entry-specific attributes to set/replace (e.g., stage, owner, amount).

tool_schemas.name: filter-list-entries-by-parent
tool_schemas.description: Returns list entries from the specified list whose parent record matches the provided parent_conditions, with optional filtering by entry_status, record_type, and record_status; results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor, and sorted by the requested sort key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID is malformed, parent_conditions is empty, any condition uses an unsupported field/operator combination (including missing value when required), limit is out of range, or sort is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or list does not exist, and raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read list entries in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the query.

list_id.description: Local list id (ULID) whose entries will be filtered.

field.description: Parent record field to filter on.

operator.description: Comparison operator applied to the parent record field.

value.description: Comparison value (omit or set null when operator is 'exists').

parent_conditions.description: Conditions applied to the parent record of each list entry.

match.description: Whether all parent conditions must match or any condition must match.

record_type.description: Restrict results to entries whose parent record has this record_type.

record_status.description: Restrict results to entries whose parent record has this status.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: filter-list-entries-by-parent-id
tool_schemas.description: Returns list entries from the specified list whose parent record_id matches the provided record_id, optionally filtered by entry status; results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor, and sorted by the requested sort key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID is malformed, limit is out of range, status is not active/removed, or sort is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace or list does not exist, and raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read list entries in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the query.

list_id.description: Local list id (ULID) whose entries will be filtered.

record_id.description: Local parent record id (ULID) to match list entries against.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list-tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks (task activities) in the specified workspace with optional filters for status, author_record_id, linked_record_id, and due date range; results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor, and sorted by the requested sort key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is malformed, any filter ID is malformed, due_before/due_after are not valid date-times, limit is out of range, or sort/status is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read tasks in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace id (ULID) to scope the task list.

author_record_id.description: Filter tasks by author record id (ULID).

linked_record_id.description: Filter tasks that are linked to a specific record id (ULID).

due_before.description: Return tasks due before this timestamp (inclusive).

due_after.description: Return tasks due after this timestamp (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create-task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task activity in the specified workspace with the provided title and optional body, due_at, author_record_id, linked_record_ids, and metadata, and returns the created task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id or any record ID is malformed, title is missing/empty, due_at is not a valid date-time, linked_record_ids is not an array of record ULIDs, or metadata is not an object. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or any provided author/linked record does not exist in the workspace, and raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to create tasks in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...) to create the task in.

author_record_id.description: Record ULID (att_rec_...) of the task author/creator.

linked_record_ids.description: Record ULIDs (att_rec_...) to link this task to on creation.

metadata.description: Arbitrary task metadata blob stored alongside the activity.

tool_schemas.name: update-task
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified task by changing its title, body, due_at (or clearing it with null), status, and/or completed_at, and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if task_id is malformed, due_at/completed_at are not valid date-times (unless due_at is null), or status is not one of active/completed/deleted. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist, raises CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed (for example, completing a deleted task or providing completed_at without setting status to completed), and raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to update the task.

due_at.description: New due date/time (ISO 8601), or null to clear.

completed_at.description: Completion timestamp (ISO 8601), typically set when status becomes completed.

metadata.description: Arbitrary task metadata blob to replace/overwrite.

tool_schemas.name: delete-task
tool_schemas.description: Description not available

tool_schemas.name: link-record-to-task
tool_schemas.description: Link a record to a task

task_id.description: Task activity ULID (att_act_...) to link against.

record_id.description: Record ULID (att_rec_...) to link to the task.

tool_schemas.name: create-record
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new record (company, person, or custom) in the specified workspace and returns the created record object. For custom records, you must provide `attio_object`; other fields such as `domain`, `email`, and `attributes` are stored when supplied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid or `attio_object` is omitted for `record_type=custom`, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if creation limits are enforced for the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (att_ws_...) to create the record in.

attio_object.description: Attio object API name/identifier for the record (required for custom records).

display_name.description: Primary display name for the record.

email.description: Primary email address (primarily for person records).

social.description: Social profiles/handles blob stored for the record.

contact.description: Contact info blob stored for the record.

business.description: Business info blob stored for the record.

attributes.description: Arbitrary Attio attributes payload for the record.

tool_schemas.name: get-record
tool_schemas.description: Lists the CRM lists that the given record belongs to within the specified workspace and returns a paged collection of list-membership entries filtered by `status` and ordered by `sort`; pagination uses `limit` and an opaque `cursor` returned with each page. Returns an empty page when the record has no memberships matching the filters. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids/params, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or record does not exist in that workspace, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to read memberships for the workspace.

record_id.description: Record ULID (att_rec_...) to retrieve list memberships for.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (att_ws_...) used to scope the memberships query.

status.description: Filter memberships by list entry status.

limit.description: Maximum number of list memberships to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update-record
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing record and returns the updated record; any provided object blobs (`social`, `contact`, `business`, `attributes`) are set/overwritten, and `status` may be changed to `active`, `archived`, or `deleted`. Only fields present in the request are updated; omitted fields are left unchanged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs (including an invalid `status`), NOT_FOUND if `record_id` does not exist, CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed by the record’s current state, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to modify the record.

display_name.description: New display name for the record.

attributes.description: Arbitrary Attio attributes payload to set/overwrite.

tool_schemas.name: delete-record
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified record and returns a confirmation of deletion (or the deleted record, depending on the service’s standard delete response). If the record is already deleted, the operation is refused rather than creating a second deletion event. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid `record_id`, NOT_FOUND if the record does not exist, CONFLICT if the record is not in a deletable state, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to delete it.

tool_schemas.name: list-records
tool_schemas.description: Lists records in a workspace matching the provided filters and returns a paginated result set sorted by `sort_by`/`sort_order`; pagination uses `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Filters include record identity fields (e.g., `attio_record_id`), exact-match fields (e.g., `display_name`, `domain`, `email`), status/type constraints, and time-range windows for created/updated/activity timestamps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including malformed timestamps or out-of-range `limit`), NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to read records in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (workspaces.id) to scope the query.

attio_object.description: Filter by upstream Attio object identifier/name stored on the record.

attio_record_id.description: Filter by upstream Attio record id.

domain.description: Filter by exact domain (typically for companies).

email.description: Filter by exact email (typically for people).

last_interaction_at_from.description: Filter for records with last_interaction_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

last_interaction_at_to.description: Filter for records with last_interaction_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

last_activity_at_from.description: Filter for records with last_activity_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

last_activity_at_to.description: Filter for records with last_activity_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

created_at_from.description: Filter for records created_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

created_at_to.description: Filter for records created_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

updated_at_from.description: Filter for records updated_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

updated_at_to.description: Filter for records updated_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: batch-create-records
tool_schemas.description: Creates up to 500 records in the given workspace in a single request and returns a batch result containing the created records (and per-item outcomes when applicable). Each item is validated independently, including `record_type` requirements and `attio_object` being required for custom records; item fields like timestamps and raw payloads are stored when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the batch is empty/too large or any record payload is structurally invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission for the workspace, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace exceeds batch or creation limits.

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (workspaces.id) to create records within.

records.description: Records to create in this batch.

attio_object.description: Upstream Attio object identifier/name to associate with this record (required for custom records).

attio_record_id.description: Upstream Attio record id to store alongside the local record.

attributes.description: Normalized attribute map for this record.

raw_json.description: Raw upstream JSON payload to store for this record.

last_interaction_at.description: Timestamp of last interaction with this record.

last_activity_at.description: Timestamp of last activity on this record.

tool_schemas.name: batch-update-records
tool_schemas.description: Update multiple records in a single batch operation

workspace_id.description: Local workspace ULID (workspaces.id) to scope updates.

records.description: Record updates to apply in this batch.

attio_record_id.description: Upstream Attio record id to set/overwrite.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for this Attio CRM Integration Server, including the resolved workspace context, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses when the provided credentials are missing/invalid or the caller is not authorized for the configured Attio connection.

authorization.description: Bearer access token or API key used to authenticate the request (same credential format as other endpoints).

tool_schemas.name: create-list
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new list in the current workspace mirror and returns the created list. Refuses invalid list_type/applies_to combinations, invalid field_config (including invalid pipeline stages), or when the caller is not authorized to create lists for the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) to scope the request.

applies_to.description: Record type this list applies to.

field_config.description: List field configuration (e.g., pipeline stages and validation rules).

tool_schemas.name: update-list
tool_schemas.description: Updates list metadata and lifecycle state for a list in the current workspace. Use status to archive/unarchive a list. Refuses attempts to transition a deleted list, invalid pipeline configuration updates, or cross-workspace access.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) to scope the request.

field_config.description: Updated list field configuration (validated for pipelines).

status.description: Lifecycle status transition for the list.

tool_schemas.name: update-record-status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a record between lifecycle states (active/archived/deleted) and returns the updated record. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g., deleted -> active), attempts to delete already-deleted records, or cross-workspace access. When transitioning to deleted, associated active list entries are marked removed and removed_at is set.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (att_ws_... ULID) to scope the request.

status.description: Target lifecycle status for the record.

metadata.name: Attio CRM Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend mirrors an Attio workspace into a local, query-optimized store to power search, advanced filtering, list membership, notes, and task workflows exposed by the Attio CRM Integration Server. Core workflows: create/update/delete company/person (and generic records), run multiple search vari
